metadata.description: The Accelerator plugin suite — turns a bare project into a governed, production-ready codebase. 34 composable plugins wired to a shared ai-baseline substrate (audit trail, PII scrub, cost gate).

plugins.name: agent-builder
plugins.description: A meta-agent that builds, audits, and publishes Claude Code agents and skills. Run /build-agent to generate a plugin from a description or audit an existing one.

plugins.name: ai-baseline
plugins.description: Mandatory baseline for every agent build — audit trail, PII scrub, cost gate, and app/feature attribution.

plugins.name: ai-eval-companion
plugins.description: Advisory companion for designing repeatable, versioned, CI-gated LLM evaluation protocols — eval set construction, LLM-as-judge rubric design, RAG metric decomposition, faithfulness testing, safety red-teaming, and CI regression gates.

plugins.name: api-designer
plugins.description: Design-first API workflow plugin: intent → resources → schemas → security → OpenAPI 3.1 spec → contract review → breaking-change detection.

plugins.name: assimilator
plugins.description: Ingests foreign agents, skills, and plugins (Claude plugin, Cursor rule, raw system prompt, OpenAI tool spec) and converts them into conformant accelerator plugins. Also extracts reusable techniques for fleet-wide adoption.

plugins.name: compliance-companion
plugins.description: EU AI Act high-risk regime tooling — human oversight gates, right-to-explanation, incident reporting, and model cards.

plugins.name: content-companion
plugins.description: Human-sounding content pipeline — draft, lint, and review docs, READMEs, blog posts, release prose, and marketing copy with an explicit anti-AI-tell discipline.

plugins.name: cost-monitor
plugins.description: Rich spend tracking on the ai-baseline audit log — per-app/feature/agent attribution, budget alerts, daily/weekly summaries.

plugins.name: data-companion
plugins.description: Data engineering review toolkit — schema review, pipeline audit, dbt model review, data quality, data contracts, lineage, naming validation, and adversarial critique.

plugins.name: databricks-engineer
plugins.description: Databricks platform capability — builds Lakeflow Declarative Pipelines, runs SQL via CLI + warehouse, authors PySpark, governs Unity Catalog, deploys Asset Bundles.

plugins.name: dependency-auditor
plugins.description: Static dependency analysis: license compliance, CVE surface (advisory-based), freshness classification, upgrade path planning, and supply chain risk — across 11 ecosystems. No live scanning.

plugins.name: dev-companion
plugins.description: Ongoing project companion — code review, security review, tech debt analysis, test generation, feature spec, design, ADR capture, and adversarial critique. Eight independent agents, no session setup required.

plugins.name: frontend-companion
plugins.description: Front-end engineering quality — component architecture, client state, accessibility, and performance — plus JS/TS/CSS language depth for browser UI codebases.

plugins.name: greenfield-project-initializer
plugins.description: Technology-agnostic, question-driven plugin that guides developers through every greenfield project phase — from requirements to working scaffold — producing durable artifacts with no unanswered assumptions.

plugins.name: incident-companion
plugins.description: Structured incident documentation plugin for engineering teams. Covers runbook generation, escalation templates, timeline reconstruction, post-mortem authoring, and adversarial post-mortem critique — with blameless culture enforced on every artifact.

plugins.name: legacy-modernizer
plugins.description: Analyzes an existing codebase and produces a phased migration roadmap: dependency modernization, framework upgrades, pattern replacement, and technical debt sequencing — with every phase leaving the project in a buildable state.

plugins.name: memory-companion
plugins.description: Cross-session, cross-plugin persistent memory backed by a file-based key-value store at .ai-memory/.

plugins.name: migration-conductor
plugins.description: Migration lifecycle — wave planning, reconciliation suites and high-volume execution, DQ gates between layers, evidence-gated cutover runbooks.

plugins.name: observability-companion
plugins.description: Structured telemetry on the ai-baseline audit log — per-agent metrics, SLO monitoring, and invocation traces.

plugins.name: onboarding-guide
plugins.description: Reads an existing codebase and generates a practical docs/onboarding.md covering architecture, entry points, data flow, local setup, testing, key concepts, and common gotchas. Eight agents in a pipeline with sensitive-content scrub as a mandatory pre-output gate.

plugins.name: ops-companion
plugins.description: CI/CD pipeline design, IaC review, secrets audit, deployment readiness, monitoring setup, and rollback planning for Claude Code.

plugins.name: pattern-miner
plugins.description: Scan a codebase for recurring patterns and conventions, critique them for signal vs. noise, and codify the survivors into a reusable per-project catalog that feeds spec enrichment and code review.

plugins.name: performance-companion
plugins.description: Advisory backend/server-side performance and scalability companion. Owns latency/throughput budgets, profiling guidance, query/DB performance, load testing strategy, caching, concurrency, and CI regression gating. Advisory-only except for a confirm-gated plan document writer.

plugins.name: polyglot-companion
plugins.description: Language-specialist depth across 8 languages (Python, Java, Kotlin, Perl, SQL, Go, Rust, C#) — per-language idioms, security pitfalls, testing conventions, and code review with cited pack rules.

plugins.name: product-companion
plugins.description: Product planning layer — personas, epics, features, user stories, a prioritized WSJF-lite backlog, and a project passport that tracks lifecycle stage. /build-next drives the top ready story through the accelerate arc: spec → enrich → plan → execute → review.

plugins.name: qa-companion
plugins.description: Test and QA strategy companion — advisory layer above individual test authorship covering test shape selection, coverage analysis, flakiness triage, suite auditing, contract testing guidance, and mutation testing. Advisory only; never generates test code.

plugins.name: release-manager
plugins.description: Release preparation pipeline — commit analysis, semantic version recommendation, changelog generation, release notes drafting, readiness gate, and tag guidance. Bridges 'code is merged' and 'release is shipped'.

plugins.name: sap-migration-companion
plugins.description: SAP migration domain knowledge — source profiling (ECC/S4), extraction and target-load advisory, migration-object mapping, cross-system harmonization, key-mapping/xref design.

plugins.name: security-companion
plugins.description: Design-level application-security and threat-modeling companion. Works at the architecture and design stage — STRIDE threat modeling, trust-boundary mapping, security design review, abuse-case elicitation, and scan-strategy advisory. Cross-links to dev-companion:security-reviewer (code-level) and ops-companion:secrets-auditor (secret scanning).

plugins.name: self-evolution-companion
plugins.description: Quality feedback loop — score agent outputs, journal results, propose prompt improvements with mandatory human approval.

plugins.name: teaching-craft
plugins.description: Workshop subject matter as skills — pedagogy decision rules, reproducible agentic failure-mode demos, agentic prompting patterns, an AI risk taxonomy with exercises, and an annotated prompt corpus. Consumed by workshop-companion agents when authoring sessions.

plugins.name: uiux-companion
plugins.description: UI/UX design quality companion — usability heuristics, design-system consistency, and visual hierarchy evaluated from spec and flow descriptions.

plugins.name: workshop-companion
plugins.description: Instructor-side workshop authoring pipeline — curriculum sequencing by prerequisite graph, per-session lesson design, goal-shaped lab authoring for learner-supplied substrate, instruction-portability dry-running, and mixed-audience track adaptation.

plugins.name: workspace-companion
plugins.description: Cross-repo workspace mapping — service dependency graph, large-codebase navigation, and dependency-ordered cross-repo change planning. Backed by an auto-bootstrapped .accelerator-workspace.yaml manifest.
